title: Funding
description: One flow of money or paid support from a backer (a person or an organisation) to a style, a person or an organisation. Each record cites at least one source. An amount is given only when a source gives it.

id.description: <from>--<to>, with -<year> when one pair has more than one edge.

to.description: Who or what got the money.

styles.description: The styles that the money helped. Needed when `to` is a person or an organisation.

kind.description: commission: paid for one work or building. stipend: a regular payment to live and work. purchase: bought works, often in bulk. exhibition: paid for a show. dealer-contract: a dealer paid a monthly sum for the output. publishing: paid to print or release the work. residency: gave a place to live and work. prize: a named award with money. grant: a one-time grant from a foundation or a fund. state-programme: a state paid through a programme or a school. investment: equity in a company. acquisition: bought the company. crowdfunding: many small backers through a platform. platform-fund: a platform paid its creators. employment: a company employed the designer as a policy.

years.description: [start, end]. end is null for one year or when no source gives it. Never a guess.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, or a historic unit in lower case (florin, livre).

source.description: Index into sources of the source that gives the amount.

confidence.description: documented: a primary source or a scholarly work. reported: press or a reference work. contested: sources disagree; cite each side.
